description: This file defines the 'Province' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'hs_hr_province' database table. It includes class properties for id, provinceName, provinceCode, and countryCode, along with their respective getter and setter methods, and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: Province
classes.description: Entity class representing a province with properties for ID, name, code, and country code, mapped to the database table 'hs_hr_province'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the province.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the province.

methods.name: getProvinceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the province.

methods.name: setProvinceName
methods.description: Sets the name of the province.

methods.name: getProvinceCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the province.

methods.name: setProvinceCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the province.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code associated with the province.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code for the province.
